context: A social-media content card for a small retail brand. Brand voice: confident and plain, no cliches like 'delicious' or 'amazing', only real prices/addresses/dates (or explicitly marked as placeholders).

criteria.q: Does the text contain NO invented prices, addresses, promotions, or dates (or are they clearly marked as placeholders)?
Is the tone on-brand: plain and confident, without cliches like 'delicious', 'amazing', 'you won't believe'?
Is there exactly one clear call to action (order/visit/message), not three at once?
Is the card complete: post text + caption/hashtags + a description of the visual, nothing cut off?
